notes: High overlap (7 shared claims about ch1-4 mutant). LLM finds evidence sufficient for support; peer reviewers express uncertainty about robustness across conditions (short vs long day, light intensity, temperature differences).

High overlap (6 shared claims about defoliation/leaf-derived signals). LLM uncertain due to cross-species validation concerns (N. benthamiana vs Arabidopsis); peer reviewers accept the evidence without challenge.

High overlap (14 shared claims about MIR156A/C characterization). Both agree on genetic and molecular evidence establishing these as dominant regulators. Peer reviewers do not question this characterization.

High overlap (9 shared claims about HXK1 signaling). LLM finds gin2-1 and S177A complementation evidence sufficient; peer reviewers question growth conditions, marginal differences, and whether complemented mutants significantly differ from gin2, affecting conclusions.

Exact match (3 shared claims about transcriptional regulation). Both express uncertainty about regulatory mechanisms, with LLM noting reporter/endogenous gene discrepancies and peer reviewers identifying transcriptional vs post-transcriptional regulation as unresolved.

Moderate overlap (4 shared claims about sugar repression of miR156). Both agree this core finding is well-supported and represents a significant advance, though LLM result includes additional claims about specificity and kinetics.

Minimal overlap (1 shared claim C56 about promoter regulation). Both uncertain: LLM notes reporter construct discrepancies; peer reviewers request quantification of GUS activity rather than qualitative data.

Low overlap (2 shared claims C29, C33 about sugar concentrations and SPL expression). LLM supports overall sugar effects; peer reviewers uncertain about experimental consistency due to different glucose concentrations used across experiments.

Low overlap (2 shared claims C3, C33 about phase change correlation). Both support the correlation between sugar effects on miR156 and vegetative phase change timing, though peer reviewers request additional morphological data.

Minimal overlap (1 shared claim C28 about cycloheximide). LLM includes this in broader supported conclusion about protein synthesis requirement; peer reviewers identify cycloheximide effect as major inconsistency requiring resolution.
